high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Bloomberg's website, viewed on Instagram. The content discusses the financial performance and market strategies of Tiffany & Co., a luxury jewelry brand, following its acquisition by LVMH (Louis Vuitton Moët Hennessy). Here’s a detailed description: The article highlights that Tiffany & Co. is known for "high jewelry," with pieces priced from $75,000 and up into the millions. According to internal estimates shared with staff, Tiffany's U.S. customers now spend an average of $2,000 per transaction
